=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/scripts/escalation_ledger.py:114 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Evidence keys whose values normalize to empty or whitespace-only strings are omitted from the fingerprint, which can make distinct failures share a fingerprint and restrict the judge's available choices.
  WHY: The reviewer rates this MAJOR; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 dispute the finding, stating that omission is intentional and the collision scenario is not a real defect.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/escalation_ledger.py:99-120 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Evidence keys whose normalized value list becomes empty after trimming whitespace are omitted from the canonical fingerprint, so distinct failure events differing only by a whitespace-only field can collide.
  WHY: A collision could cause the judge to treat a new failure as already decided and refuse a repeated budget or descope choice; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 dispute the finding as intentional behavior.
- .claude/scripts/escalation_ledger.py:172 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_read_log` raises `LedgerError` when the log contains invalid UTF-8, causing the script to exit with code 2.
  WHY: The reviewer rates this MAJOR; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 dispute the finding, stating that failing closed on a corrupted safety-critical ledger is intentional.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/escalation_ledger.py:167-173 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_read_log` catches `UnicodeDecodeError` and re-raises it as `LedgerError`, causing exit code 2.
  WHY: A log with unexpected encoding or corruption leaves the escalation unhandled and the project blocked; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 dispute the finding, stating that fail-closed behavior is intentional.
- .claude/commands/escalation-judge.md:step 6 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Step 6 directs the judge to post an escalation comment next to the blocker, but legacy mode has no on-platform blocker comment or valid target.
  WHY: The reviewer severity ranges from NIT to MAJOR; using the highest, MAJOR, the missing comment makes the marker-based recovery path unavailable for legacy-mode projects.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/escalation-judge.md:step 6 and step 8 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The judge assumes the blocker is on an issue or PR, leaving step 6 without a comment target and the close-path report without a thread in legacy mode.
  WHY: The reviewer rates this MAJOR; the missing on-thread escalation marker also removes the recovery trail described by AD-4.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/escalation-judge.md:step 6 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Step 6 assumes a blocker comment exists to post the escalation marker next to, but legacy mode keeps the blocker in the report only.
  WHY: Legacy mode has no on-platform target for the marker, so future resume cannot recover the ES-<n> entry from the issue or PR comments.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:"Progress Log" template, the `- Stage:` line | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Stage value template does not enumerate the `<stage> — budget ES-<n>` value that the judge produces for budget grants.
  WHY: A later parser relying on the template's value list could misclassify a budgeted round's Stage value as unknown.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The stop now posts `<!-- ai:claude-blocked:v1 kind=escalation stop=<stop id> -->` (on the source issue in issue mode, otherwise on the final PR) and hands its project checker an `escalation` wait. The checker starts the judge … The judge picks one choice … and hands the checker the next stage."
  expected_change_site: `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/escalation-judge.md` step 6 and the close branch of step 8
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both step 6 and the close branch say "next to the blocker (the same issue or PR)" / "on the blocker's thread", with no fallback for legacy mode where the blocker has no on-platform comment per implement-plan-claude.md "At an escalation stop" step 2 ("in the report only"). A legacy-mode close would have nowhere on-platform to post and the `ai:claude-escalation:v1` comment — the only recovery trail under AD-4 — would not exist for the next session. The fix is one line: state that legacy mode skips the MCP call and writes the marker only into the log/report.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
